definitions: A thick, viscous substance secreted by the mucous membranes of the respiratory passages, especially when produced in excessive quantities, e.g. during a cold or asthma attack.
One of the four humours of ancient and medieval physiology, believed to be associated with apathetic or sluggish temperament.
examples: He coughed up a lot of phlegm.
The doctor examined the phlegm sample.
According to ancient beliefs, an excess of phlegm made one lethargic.
